notes: Measured on mainnet data by the author's deployment. CI = 95 % Wilson interval. Definitions in docs/validation.md.

recall_completed_swaps.method: share of offer-matched, non-round swap locks whose spend reached the top tier, minus chance matches (offers shifted by one day)

PART.note: no offer-matched swaps since 2026-10-10; structural share of BasicSwap-shaped spends that reach the top tier (blind swaps recognised since 2026-11-20)

BCH.note: covenant swaps are recognised by template (certain tier); no offer-matched sample

early_detection_btc.method: lock output (P2WSH) at mempool or block time, amount equal to exactly one live offer, tx version 2, nLockTime 0, at most 2 outputs, amount not a multiple of 1000 sat; precision = share later completed or refunded as a swap (outputs older than 6 h)

amount_only_matcher_btc.note: matching on the amount alone (no transaction-shape rules) is weak: precision 1.2 % / 25.6 % / 34.4 % at recall 91 / 82 / 82 % for three rule sets on 144 blocks

findings: JSON writer escaped non-ASCII per byte instead of per code point (fixed, regression self-test)

not_adopted.height_based_lock_nlocktime_for_top_tier: tested 2026-11-20: 46 extra spends, 0 of 35 offer-matched where 3.3 were expected (chance 1.6 %)
